name: Paguroideo
source:
Paguroideo is a visual novel that uses elements like surrealism and dissociation to explore themes of alienation, identity, and aquariums, I think?

[From [url=https://areqreepy.itch.io/paguroideo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我认为《Paguroideo》是一部视觉小说，它使用超现实主义和解离等元素来探索疏离、身份和水族馆等主题？

[来自[url=https://areqreepy.itch.io/paguroideo]Itch.io[/url]]
